description: This Java source file defines Swagger API response and request classes for Staff API endpoints within the Apache Fineract project. It includes classes for creating, updating staff, and their responses, annotated for Swagger documentation.

classes.name: StaffApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Container class with nested static classes representing Swagger models for Staff API responses and requests.

classes.name: StaffApiResourceSwagger.CreateStaffResponse
classes.description: Represents the response payload for staff creation, including officeId and resourceId.

classes.name: StaffApiResourceSwagger.PutStaffRequest
classes.description: Represents the request payload for updating staff, including fields isLoanOfficer and externalId.

classes.name: StaffApiResourceSwagger.UpdateStaffResponse
classes.description: Represents the response payload for staff update, including officeId, resourceId, and nested change details.

classes.name: StaffApiResourceSwagger.UpdateStaffResponse.PutStaffResponseChanges
classes.description: Nested class within UpdateStaffResponse indicating changed fields (isLoanOfficer, externalId).
